data.title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
data.preamble: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of September 1, 2026 by and between John Doe, of Acme Corp, and Alice, of Northwind Labs.

clauses.heading: Parties and Effective Date
clauses.text: The Parties are John Doe of Acme Corp ("Disclosing Party") and Alice of Northwind Labs ("Receiving Party"), collectively referred to as the "Parties." This Agreement shall become effective on September 1 2026 ("Effective Date").

clauses.heading: Definition of Confidential Information
clauses.text: Confidential Information means any non-public information disclosed by a Party to the other Party, whether oral, written, or electronic, that relates to the logistics integration project, including but not limited to technical data, business plans, and proprietary processes.

clauses.heading: Obligations of Receiving Party
clauses.text: Each Receiving Party shall (a) protect the Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care it uses to protect its own similar information, but no less than reasonable care; (b) use the Confidential Information solely for the purpose of performing the logistics integration project; and (c) not disclose the Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written consent of the disclosing Party, except as required by law.

clauses.heading: Exclusions
clauses.text: Confidential Information does not include information that (i) is or becomes publicly known through no fault of the Receiving Party; (ii) was rightfully known by the Receiving Party prior to disclosure; (iii) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without reference to the Confidential Information; or (iv) is rightfully obtained from a third party without restriction.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect for a period of two (2) years from the Effective Date, unless earlier terminated by mutual written agreement of the Parties.

clauses.heading: Return or Destruction of Confidential Information
clauses.text: Upon termination of this Agreement, or upon the disclosing Party's written request, each Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information and certify in writing that it has done so.

clauses.heading: Remedies
clauses.text: The Parties acknowledge that monetary damages may be insufficient to remedy a breach of this Agreement and that the disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief, in addition to any other rights and remedies available at law or in equity.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-law principles.

data.signature_block: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement as of the Effective Date.

findings.message: The clause assigns fixed roles of 'Disclosing Party' to John Doe and 'Receiving Party' to Alice, which contradicts the mutual nature of the NDA where both parties disclose and receive confidential information.
Obligations are imposed only on the 'Receiving Party' (defined as Alice), leaving John Doe without explicit obligations to protect Alice's confidential information.
The return/destruction obligation applies only to the 'Receiving Party' (Alice), not mutually.

findings.message: The definition refers to information disclosed by 'a Party to the other Party' but the Parties clause defines only one disclosing party, creating ambiguity about whether Alice's disclosures are covered.
The agreement specifies New York governing law without any indication in the request that this was agreed; this may be one-sided if parties are located elsewhere.
The effective date is written as 'September 1 2026' without a comma, while the preamble uses 'September 1, 2026'; inconsistency in date formatting.
The counterparty's last name is blank in the request and the draft uses only 'Alice'; consider including a placeholder or confirming the full legal name.
